newsitem.title: USA: PCX to list Legg Mason, two other options.
newsitem.headline: PCX to list Legg Mason, two other options.

text.p: The Pacific Exchange (PCX) said Monday it would begin trading options on Legg Mason Inc, Pediatrix Medical Group Inc and Tower Automotive Inc on May 1.
The exchange said Legg Mason options would open with strike prices of 40, 45 and 50 and initial expirations in May, June, August and November.
Pediatrix options will have opening strikes of 25, 30 and 35, with initial expirations in May, June, August and November.
Tower Automotive will have opening strikes of 30, 35 and 40 and initial expirations in May, June, August and November.
Position limits for all three options have been set at 4,500 contracts each and they have been allocated to pit rep Shannon Brandt in the General Mills Inc trading crowd, the PCX said.
